_description: Defines monitoring for Apple Volume Purchase Program (VPP) tokens used for managed app deployment.
description: VPP tokens authorize Microsoft Intune to deploy and manage apps purchased through Apple Business Manager's volume purchase program.

businessImpact.summary: VPP token expiry prevents Intune from deploying or updating managed apps purchased through Apple Business Manager.

steps: Sign in to Apple Business Manager
Navigate to Settings > Payments and Billing > Apps and Books
Navigate to Microsoft Intune Admin Center
Go to Apps > iOS/iPadOS > iOS VPP Tokens
Select the token and upload the new server token
